note: Phase 4 prompt templates, revision 4 -- the user's own format. A prompt is eight parts in fixed order, each picked independently: subject, addon, view, layout, background, style, outlines, palette. Aspect ratio is deliberately absent: the image generator sets it, and that is the user's call, not the program's. Unit class plays no part: the prompt reads the same for every class, and which reference image to load is the user's pick.
subject: {subject} as a game sprite in the style of Advance Wars.

bold.label: Bold simple shape
bold.text: A bold simple shape that stays readable when scaled down very small.

detailed.label: Highly detailed
detailed.text: A highly detailed shape that shows off meticulous detail.

three_quarter.label: Elevated 3/4 orthographic
three_quarter.text: Slightly elevated three-quarters orthographic side-view with visible top and front surfaces.

oblique.label: Oblique, 45-degree slant
oblique.text: Oblique side view with a depth slant of up and right with a 45-degree depth angle.

single.label: Single
single.text: One subject seen in full, centered and isolated, filling the frame.

sheet.label: Sheet
sheet.text: A grid of {count} of them, {grid}, evenly spaced with wide flat gaps, every one the same size and from the same angle, but each a distinct design.

layout.grid_note: Capped at 16. Krea returned 85 unreadable blobs when left uncapped (docs/generator-findings.md).

background.key_note: Only options with a 'key' can go through the converter: convert.py chroma-keys green or magenta. The themed backgrounds are for concept art and anything you will cut out by hand.

style: Chunky low-resolution pixel art with crisp stepped pixel edges, large deliberate pixel clusters, compact readable silhouette, and layered flat pixel shading. Small bright highlights, and strong light-dark separation. Clearly defined surface detail picked out in flat tone.

keep.label: Keep reference colors
keep.text: Keep the same color palette and style as original image.

described.label: Described colors
described.text: Warm coral-red, orange-peach and pale peach body colors with dark burgundy and muted purple-gray shadow clusters.

palette.palette_note: Optional color request, last in the prompt. 'keep' is for edit mode (October 2026: Venice.ai's Edit Image with Nano Banana 2 Lite), where the reference sheet is the image being edited: it keeps the model on Orange Star's colors and AW's style. Without a reference the model picks its own colors whatever the prompt says -- 'described' gets close but drifts unit to unit (cars2.jpg), and the old hex-code option was removed because the model painted the hex codes on as car paint (cars.jpeg). The fixer snaps every color anyway.
